about: Hard questions for Ask a Question (specs/ask-a-question.md section 6.7): phrasings the panel can't answer as asked. 'model' is what the real model (Ollama, qwen2.5:3b) answered when probed on 2026-09-28 - tests/test_ask_hard.py replays those real guesses. 'failed_because' is what went wrong before the problems were detected: in 13 of these a table was shown that answered a different question, with no warning. 'expect' is the behaviour now: an explanation instead of a table ('unsupported' + code), or a table with a notice ('answer' + notice code). Also runnable against the live model: scripts/eval_ask.py --file backend/tests/ask_questions_hard.json.

cases.failed_because: An unknown branch name was dropped, so every branch was shown.

A country outside the data was dropped, so every country was shown.

cases.q: what is our return on assets
cases.failed_because: 'assets' matched part of the phrase, so total assets was shown.

cases.q: difference in CAR between 21 Sep and 28 Sep
